summary: qsort-style comparator. Each argument is a pointer to an object pointer (arg+0x0). Sums the float at obj+0x738 and the float at obj+0x740 for both operands and returns -1/0/1 ordering by the larger total speed sum.

local_names.a1: left comparator operand (pointer to object pointer)
local_names.a2: right comparator operand (pointer to object pointer)
local_names.v2: speed sum of object referenced by a1
local_names.v3: speed sum of object referenced by a2

operations.description: Load object pointer stored at a1+0x0, then compute v2 = float[obj+0x740] + float[obj+0x738] (offsets 1856 and 1848 in decimal).
Load object pointer stored at a2+0x0, then compute v3 = float[obj+0x740] + float[obj+0x738].
If v2 > v3, comparator yields positive ordering.
Return 1 when the first operand's speed sum is strictly greater.
If v2 >= v3 (equality case), comparator yields neutral ordering.
Return 0 when the two speed sums are equal.
Return -1 when the second operand's speed sum is strictly greater.
